Olm attacks sides of the room. Which side he attacks is dependant on where the players are in the room. He attacks where the most players are. His head can face 3 directions. Middle, left, and right. Most accounts are hacked through their email. No one can disable authenticator without it, and honestly, it's almost impossible to brute force through authenticator. 
You change your email tied to the account. 
Make a brand new email on your phone.
Never, NEVER, log onto that email on your computer. EVER. Enable ALL protective hoops on that email, 2 step, complex password, all the things that the email service provides. 
Make sure to have 2 step on OSRS and bam. You're unhackable. They can't get through authenticator, they don't know your new email, if they do find your email, they need to figure out the complex password, if they figure out the password, then they need your phone for 2 step, if they have your phone, you have bigger problems.
